purpose: 原创诊断集：验证词义、逻辑与表达，不用于证明专业级水平
reviewer_notes: 检查点不得进入生成提示词。两个成员必须属于同一数据划分。接受合理同义表达，不做单一参考译文的逐字匹配；这是已公开的诊断集，不能作为无泄漏测试集。

groups.challenge: corporation 的历史与商业词义

cases.text: In this account of medieval institutions, corporations include guilds, universities, and religious communities. Their rules influenced political representation.
checks: corporations 指广义组织或法人团体，不统一限为商业公司
保留三个例子及其与政治代表制度的关系

cases.text: The corporation reported higher quarterly profits and paid a dividend to its shareholders.
checks: 这里是商业公司，不机械套用历史语境词义
保留季度利润上升及向股东分红两项信息

cases.text: The stakes are high: a wrongful conviction could cost an innocent person years of freedom.
checks: 表达事关重大，不添加具体赌局
could 的可能性与无辜者失去自由的后果均保留

cases.text: At this poker table, the stakes are high: the minimum bet is ten thousand dollars.
checks: 保留真实扑克下注情境
最低下注金额与币种准确

cases.text: The village organized shared ventures, including repairing the bridge and maintaining the communal well.
checks: ventures 为共同活动或事务，不凭空变成创业
保留修桥与维护公共水井

cases.text: The fund invests in new commercial ventures founded by first-time entrepreneurs.
checks: 此处有明确商业创业语境
保留基金投资、创业者首次创业的限定

cases.text: The story was invented when victory was already within reach.
checks: 胜利当时已可企及或近在眼前
不能扩大成胜利之前的任意时间

cases.text: The story was invented long before victory seemed possible.
checks: 编造时胜利远未显得可能
不套用近在眼前的解释

cases.text: Under this rule, we will fail to convict some people who are guilty.
checks: 保留 will 的判断强度，不无依据增加可能
保留部分有罪者未被定罪的范围

cases.text: Under this rule, we may fail to convict some people who are guilty.
checks: 保留 may 的可能性，不改为必然
与 G05-A 的强度差别可辨识

cases.text: A majority is sufficient to approve the motion; unanimity is not required.
checks: 多数同意足以通过，不需全体一致
不只逐字输出多数的充分性而使关系不清

cases.text: A majority is not sufficient to approve the motion; unanimity is required.
checks: 多数同意不足，必须全体一致
两个否定范围均正确

cases.text: The delegate's decision binds the group she represents, even if some members disagree.
checks: 约束效力作用于被代表群体
不改成代表强迫成员赞同
保留部分成员不同意也受约束的条件

cases.text: The delegate's recommendation does not bind the group she represents, even if most members support it.
checks: 建议没有约束效力
多数支持不改变其无约束性质

cases.text: The study found an association between the policy and lower costs, but did not establish that the policy caused the reduction.
checks: 关联不等于已证实因果
保留研究并未确立因果的限制

cases.text: The report claims that the policy caused the reduction in costs; the authors present this as a causal conclusion.
checks: 因果结论属于报告作者的主张
不自行弱化为仅有关联
不将作者主张无归因地写成译者认可的事实

cases.text: Not all members who received the notice attended the meeting.
checks: 并非所有收到通知的成员都参加
不能写成所有成员均未参加

cases.text: None of the members who received the notice attended the meeting.
checks: 收到通知的成员中无人参加
不能弱化为仅部分未参加

cases.text: The transformer converts the high voltage to a lower voltage before power reaches the instrument.
checks: transformer 为电气设备变压器
保留先降压再向仪器供电的顺序

cases.text: The transformer uses self-attention to process the token sequence. The implementation is written in PyTorch.
checks: transformer 为模型架构，不译为变压器
保留自注意力、token 序列与 PyTorch 产品名称

groups.challenge: 代词消歧与原有歧义保留

cases.text: Mira gave Lena the key because Lena had lost hers. Mira kept the spare.
checks: 丢钥匙的是 Lena
交钥匙和保留备用钥匙的是 Mira

cases.text: Mira told Lena that her key had been found.
checks: 原文没有唯一确定 her 的指向
不凭空锁定钥匙所有者，允许保留歧义

groups.challenge: 断行整理与真实连字符

cases.text:
The rules influenced the evolution of political institu-
tions across the region.
checks: 识别 institutions 的断行，不把残词当作专名或漏掉
保留整个地区这一范围

cases.text:
The committee proposed a long-
term plan. Keep the filename `long-term-plan_v2.md` unchanged.
checks: long-term 的真实连字符不应被盲目消除
文件名 long-term-plan_v2.md 逐字保留
